pictures.name: CKP1-Old-Monk
pictures.prompt: An earthen walking path in a monastery garden at night, lit by a few small oil lamps. Cakkhupala (an elderly Indian monk with a lean, gentle face, eyes closed or clouded, shaved head, an ochre robe, walking slowly) walks it slowly and carefully, one hand slightly raised, his face peaceful. Deep blue night, warm gold lamp glow, tall dark trees.
